newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's buys 90 pct of contracting firm.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's buys 90 pct of contracting firm.

text.p: Egyptian real estate firm Medinet Nasr Housing and Development said it had bought 90 percent of the state-owned Nasr Public Utilities and Installation for 36 million pounds ($10.6 million).
Medinet Nasr said in an announcement published on Sunday it had bought 450,000 shares of the state firm at 80 pounds per share. The employees of the state firm own 10 percent.

The state last year offered to sell the firm to the public through sealed bids and in December, corporate sources had said that unidentified Arab investors had bought 90 percent of the firm for the same total price of 36 million.
The shares of Medinet Nasr were trading on Sunday at between 445 and 470 pounds.
